intro: Enter your domain to generate and open hundreds of third-party stat, WHOIS, and SEO lookup URLs from your browser. Helpful for audits—not a guarantee of backlinks or rankings.

faq.q: Does this tool guarantee SEO rankings?
faq.a: No. It only helps you run common lookup and ping workflows in your browser. Search engines decide rankings independently.

faq.q: Is my domain sent to your server?
faq.a: No. URL generation and batch runs execute in your browser. Third-party lookup sites you open may log their own requests.
IFrame is quietest for batch lookups; Tab or popup mode if a site blocks embedding; Ping uses public CORS proxies and may fail often.
Bulk automated links can look unnatural. Use this as a research helper and focus on quality content, partnerships, and editorial links.

faq.q: Do I need an account or payment?
faq.a: No. The Free Backlink Generator is free to use in your browser with no sign-up. Optional on-page ads support hosting; the tool itself does not require payment.
